description: Puts collections and sources on pause or takes them off it, for one language — e.g. "study only my Travel collection this week", "pause the news words", "resume everything". action: "pause" or "resume" the listed ones; "only" — resume the listed ones and pause every other collection and source of the language; "resume_all" — take every pause off (lists ignored). Collections are named by uuid or exact title and sources by bookKey or exact title, as the learning-pause list reports them. A paused item gives the automatic «Now learning» sessions no words and is not counted in goals or reminders; opening it in the app still studies it. commit=true writes; without it the call returns a preview of the changes and the resulting state.

collections.description: Collections by uuid or exact title.

commit.description: True writes. Default false returns a preview without writing.

sources.description: Sources by bookKey (catalog:… / imported:…) or exact title.

targetLang.description: The learned language, e.g. en, de, es, fr.

name: lingard_set_learning_pauses
title: Set Lingard Learning Pauses
